rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something pleasingly beautiful, including a pretty view or sunset.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jat6 lok6 zan1 hai6 hou2 leng3

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that a landscape is so beautiful it looks like a painting rather than merely saying it is pretty.

example.english: The scenery below the mountain is picturesque, like a painting.
example.traditional: 山下湖光山色，風景如畫。
example.jyutping: saan1 haa6 wu4 gwong1 saan1 sik1 fung1 ging2 jyu4 waak6
